messages.subject: Project Falcon - board approval 26 Nov
messages.plaintextBody:
James - we're taking Project Falcon to the Verdant board on 26 November for approval to sign. Could you send a short summary of the final terms I can put in the board pack? I'll circulate the board minutes once approved.

Nadia

messages.snippet: Nadia - summary for the pack: supply price £62.4m; annual licence £840k; annual service charge £1.95
messages.subject: RE: Project Falcon - board approval 26 Nov
messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia - summary for the pack: supply price £62.4m; annual licence £840k; annual service charge £1.95m; 7-year LTSA; availability 97.5% (likely to land 97.75% after negotiation); cap 125% trailing Charges / £15m supply super-cap (likely 135% / £17.5m). I've noted both the draft and likely-final positions so the board approves the range.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
